title: Mold Remediation Unit Prices for Removal, Cleaning and Coating
content:
Estimating unit prices for Mold Remediation surface work, by tier. All rates are in US dollars per square foot of the surface treated.

| Item | Spot | Limited | Standard | Extensive | Attic and Crawlspace | HVAC System |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HEPA vacuuming, per sq ft (USD) | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.52 | 0.47 | 0.58 | 0.52 |
| Drywall removal and bagging, per sq ft (USD) | 2.35 | 2.35 | 2.18 | 1.96 | 2.35 | 2.35 |
| Insulation removal and bagging, per sq ft (USD) | 1.45 | 1.45 | 1.38 | 1.24 | 1.62 | 1.45 |
| Antimicrobial application, per sq ft (USD) | 0.41 | 0.41 | 0.41 | 0.37 | 0.44 | 0.41 |
| Encapsulant coating, per sq ft (USD) | 0.89 | 0.89 | 0.89 | 0.80 | 0.94 | 0.89 |
| Wire brushing and HEPA sanding, per sq ft (USD) | 1.86 | 1.86 | 1.86 | 1.67 | 1.86 | 1.86 |
| Soda blasting, per sq ft (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3.25 | 0.00 |
| Dry ice blasting, per sq ft (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4.10 | 0.00 |
| Media blasting available | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |

**Scope of each line.**

1. HEPA vacuuming covers the surfaces within the work area.
2. Drywall removal and insulation removal each cover removal and bagging of the mold-affected material.
3. Antimicrobial application covers cleaned framing and sheathing.
4. Encapsulation is a mold-resistant encapsulant coating.
5. Wire brushing and HEPA sanding cover framing.
6. Soda blasting and dry ice blasting cover sheathing and framing; the media blasting row states whether media blasting, soda or dry ice, is an available method on the tier.

**Points on the schedule.**

- Attic and Crawlspace Mold Remediation is the only tier with Yes in the media blasting row, at 3.25 for soda blasting and 4.10 for dry ice blasting; every other tier carries 0.00 for both.
- Standard Mold Remediation carries 2.18 for drywall and 1.38 for insulation removal; Extensive Mold Remediation carries the lowest removal prices, 1.96 and 1.24.
- Worked illustration, hypothetical inputs: 37 square feet of encapsulant at a rate of 0.94 comes to 34.78.
